options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name (<label for> the control).

options.name: control
options.description: The native control to wrap; moved into the host. It receives an id if it has none. Choice, file, hidden, button, date/time (date, time, datetime-local, month, week), range, and color input types are rejected.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: required
options.description: Sets the native required property and the indicator. When omitted, the control's own required attribute is used.

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation after native constraints; return a message to mark the value invalid. string[] for <select multiple>.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are replaced by the chrome and the control.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The control's name, or null when empty.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; recomputed on each render.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Value differs from the value at creation.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Re-read native constraints, setCustomValidity() state, and the value after changing them in code.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now (marks the field submitted) and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user types. null or '' clears it.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the value (or selected options) captured at creation and clear dirty/touched/submitted/custom-error state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove the chrome, listeners, registration, and subscription; restore the consumer's aria-describedby. The control stays in the host.

events.name: aui-input
events.description: Native input event on the control.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: Native change event on the control.

contentAreas.name: control
contentAreas.description: The consumer's native element, placed between the label and the help text.

cssClasses.name: aui-form-field--invalid
cssClasses.description: Host modifier while a message is shown.

cssClasses.name: aui-form-field__control
cssClasses.description: Added to the native control: AbsoluteUI control surface.
